description: Details required by Condition 5 (Sustainable Drainage Systems Strategy) of planning permission PP/22/04697 (Railings amendments and installation of disabled access lift from pavement to entrance; replacement of ground floor and basement windows with double glazed units in painted timber slimline frames to match existing finishes and window sections; external terraces with pergolas around courtyard; mews stair and courtyard entrance to the mews; rear penthouse and rooftop design amendments; external lighting proposals; renovation of and amendments to existing AC units; rear extensions at 1st, 2nd, 3rd floor levels and reinstatement of historic roof profile with mansard walls and dormer windows to rear to extend existing rooms (as approved under ref. PP/22/00962))
